targets.title: The Impact of Resource Scarcity on Price-Quality Judgments
targets.evidence_quote: In this sixth installment of Data Replicada, we report our attempt to replicate a recently published Journal of Consumer Research (JCR) article entitled, “The Impact of Resource Scarcity on Price-Quality Judgments” ( .html ).
targets.outcome_quote: On the one hand, we were successful at dramatically reducing attrition. On the other hand, we were unsuccessful at reducing differential attrition, as once again many more participants dropped out of the Scarcity condition than the Control condition. So then we gave up, and decided to call the whole thing “inconclusive.”
targets.outcome_reasoning: Authors explicitly call the entire attempt inconclusive because differential attrition compromised random assignment and valid comparison, despite initial significant effects. Aggregate includes the additional attempts discussed in footnote 7.
